acme_infra: After upgrading to redwood-sdk==1.12 we're seeing intermittent 401s and extra billing on retries. Rolling back to previous release stopped it. Anyone seen this?
maria_support: Sorry — can you paste error logs and pip freeze?
acme_infra: logs:
```
2025-04-12T14:32:01Z ERROR request_id=hz9k 401 "Unauthorized" POST /v1/generate
2025-04-12T14:32:01Z DEBUG retried 1 time, token present=true request_id=hz9k
2025-04-12T14:32:02Z INFO charge tokens=120 request_id=hz9k
```
pip freeze:
```
redwood-sdk==1.12.0
requests==2.31.0
```
samir_eng: sounds like the 1.12 transport/auth change. There's a regression where Authorization isn't reattached for non-idempotent retries in some session configs — causes 401 on retry while server may have processed partial work so billing happens.
maria_support: can you produce a minimal repro (python or curl) so we can escalate?
acme_infra: minimal repro: create client with API key, loop generate calls and simulate transient network drop (e.g. iptables briefly). ~1 in 10 requests fail with 401 on retry. No custom transport used.
sre_jin: finance alerted — observed org billing spike this morning :eyes:
samir_eng: short-term: pin to 1.11.2:
```
pip install "redwood-sdk==1.11.2"
```
or as a stopgap in 1.12 attach auth header manually and disable retries for non-idempotent calls:
```python
import os
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=None)
# temporary: set header on underlying transport
c._transport.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {os.environ['RW_API_KEY']}"
# disable retries for write endpoints
c._transport.retries = 0
```
Note: uses internal attrs; not ideal but works until patch.
maria_support: @acme_infra can you try the pin and confirm? If they can't pin, try header workaround; we'll fast-track this.
acme_infra: pinned to 1.11.2 — errors stopped immediately. Thanks.
samir_eng: root cause: 1.12 removed top-level `auth` param and deferred header hydration. In races the header could be omitted on retry. Created ticket S-4521. Hotfix will re-attach auth to retry payloads and add integration tests for non-idempotent retry paths. Target: 1.12.1 within 24h.
maria_support: escalation notes: S-4521; workaround: pin to 1.11.2 or set header; recommend disabling retries for blocking endpoints. We'll prepare customer advisory and billing remediation steps.
devops_bot: ALERT: spike detected — customer=acme-corp usage +480% 2025-04-12T14:35Z
samir_eng: PR opened, will post release notes and migration snippet in this thread when cut.
acme_infra: appreciate the rapid response. Please share PR link and any CI checks to watch.
samir_eng: will follow up here with PR and changelog.
